subject: Burn-rate projection & invoice scenarios — follow-up from today's discovery
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@ariadnelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Burn-rate projection & invoice scenarios — follow-up from today's discovery

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and three action items so we can align the pilot scope and the invoice estimate for procurement. I pasted conservative math below and attached the worksheet I mentioned.

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: replace manual triage + search with an assistant for clinical research onboarding (multi-turn, context up to ~2k tokens).
- Target pilot: 3 months; primary metrics: reduction in human triage time and accuracy on intent classification.
- Procurement constraint: Ariadne mentioned FY27 allocation and a desire to keep initial spend under roughly $250k total.

Assumptions used in the attached workbook (ARI-token-burn-projections.xlsx):
- Expected call volume during pilot: 20k sessions/month
- Average prompt tokens per session: 120 tokens (including metadata)
- Average model completion tokens per session: 380 tokens
- Total tokens/month = (120 + 380) * 20,000 = 10,000,000 tokens/month (10M) — note: this is conservative.

Three invoice scenarios (monthly):
1) Baseline model (full fp16, lowest-latency variant): $1,150 per 1M tokens => 10M tokens = $11,500/month
2) Quantized/Optimized inference variant: $420 per 1M tokens => 10M tokens = $4,200/month
3) Reserved Dedicated capacity (committed throughput + 20% discount on unit): effective $336 per 1M tokens => 10M tokens = $3,360/month (requires 3-month reserved commit or monthly blended commit)

Pilot-level invoice totals (3 month window, inclusive of modest infra & support uplift):
- Scenario A (baseline): ~$36,900 total
- Scenario B (quantized): ~$11,700 total
- Scenario C (reserved commit): ~$10,080 total

Next steps / asks from Ariadne:
- Confirm whether the 10M tokens/month estimate matches your internal instrumentation (or share your session counts).
- Confirm budget target for pilot (you mentioned an FY27 allocation — shop for a hard cap we should use in the workbook).
- If you want a formal quote for procurement, reply with preferred scenario (A/B/C) and whether you need an SOW or PO-first flow.

I've attached the workbook and a one-page invoice scenarios PDF. If helpful, we can run a short 45-minute "budget workshop" with your procurement + engineering next Tue to lock assumptions.

Attachment stubs:
- [ARI-token-burn-projections.xlsx (spreadsheet, 165KB)]
- [ARI-invoice-scenarios.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

Thanks — I can schedule the workshop or produce a DocuSign-ready quote once you confirm which scenario to formalize.

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@ariadnelabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 14:53:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Burn-rate projection & invoice scenarios — follow-up from today's discovery

Thanks Logan — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Our current telemetry suggests closer to 8–12M tokens/month for the first 90-day pilot (so your 10M baseline is reasonable).
- Important constraint: procurement is unlikely to approve a monthly run-rate over ~$45k without additional executive approval. Our FY27 allocation for this initiative is $250k but we want a runway to scale if pilot proves out.
- Preference: If the quantized/optimized path gets to parity on accuracy, we'd prefer that — lower cost and easier to justify.

Can you confirm whether the reserved commit option requires an upfront payment or just an MRR-style committed capacity? Also please add a row to the workbook showing an additional mid-point case at $700 per 1M tokens so we can see a blended view.

—Sara
Sara Kim
Head of Research Ops
Ariadne Labs
sara.kim@ariadnelabs.com | +1 (617) 555-4321
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@ariadnelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Burn-rate projection & invoice scenarios — follow-up from today's discovery

Thanks Sara — answers inline and I uploaded an updated sheet with the $700/1M mid-point. Short answers:
- Reserved commit: requires a short contract for committed throughput (monthly billing with a minimum monthly commitment). We can structure it as MRR with a 3-month commitment for the pilot (no large upfront payment required). The discount tier we modeled (~20%) applies to committed volume over the term. I'll have Legal draft the simple terms once you confirm the scenario.
- I've added a "mid-point" line at $700 per 1M tokens and a sensitivity table ( +/- 30% volume ).

Proposed immediate next steps (pick one):
A) Budget workshop (45 minutes) — procurement + eng + Logan/Marissa. I can bring a one-slide SOW sketch and the invoice worksheet.
B) We prepare a DocuSign-ready pilot quote for Scenario C (reserved commit) with a 3-month term at the mid-point $700/1M and your target cap of $45k/mo baked in (we'd size the committed throughput so the effective monthly invoice does not exceed $45k).
C) Technical POC first — we run a 2-week integration and instrument token burn; Redwood will provide a free test token bundle (up to 1M tokens) to validate average token counts before finalizing the quote.

Let me know which you prefer and we'll move forward. I put the updated workbook here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-Ariadne-BurnModel (read/comment).

—
Logan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@ariadnelabs.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Burn-rate projection & invoice scenarios — follow-up from today's discovery

Looping in a quick internal note and an attachment for procurement:
- Internal note: if Ariadne wants to cap at $45k/mo for the pilot, we can size a reserved commit that targets ~60–70% utilization to allow headroom; this will reduce unit cost and keep month-to-month flexibility.
- I attached a one-page procurement brief that maps the $45k cap to committed volume and the resulting blended unit $/1M tokens for a 3-month pilot.

Attachment stub: [ARI-procurement-brief.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]

Sara — if you pick option B, we'll produce the DocuSign package by EOD tomorrow and include the brief as an appendix. If you pick A, I'll schedule the workshop and include procurement and our engineering lead.

—Marissa
